name: m365
description: /m365 and /m365-raw: relay a question to the Microsoft 365 Copilot desktop app through UI Automation and show the reply in the session, with the conversation so far attached in compressed form. /m365 adds response profiles from m365.json (fixed instructions, JSON answers) and embedded text files. Runs as slash commands, so the Copilot CLI model is not called. Windows only.
